hooks.command: bash -c 'CMD=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if [ -n "$CMD" ] && echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "(^|;|&&|\|)\s*git\s+push"; then echo "⛔ BLOCKED: git push requires explicit permission. Ask user first." >&2; exit 1; fi'
bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS"; if [[ -n "$FILE" && "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$ ]]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && bunx biome check --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi'
